entries.enter: I've been wearing this flower for quite a while, but I'm still a little worried the two sides might look uneven.
entries.held: (A little embarrassed) I wish you were here beside me. You could help me check how it looks.

entries.enter: I'm rather reluctant to mess up these flowers today.
entries.held: (Her voice softens) But if you want to hug me... a little messiness wouldn't matter.

restored.text: I've put so much care into getting dressed today. I also want to spend some quality time talking with you.

random.text: I'm going to wear flowers this time. Just let me get ready.

affectionScenes.enter: I want to take my time walking when I'm dressed like this for a date.
affectionScenes.held: (Her voice softens) I want to link arms with you and walk together a little farther.
